    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                             October 9 2026
          GBOS Special Meeting: Rules and Procedures Part 2
                              Minutes Final
        12:00 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 12:05 p.m.  Kellie Okonek, Co-Chair

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call: Brian Burnett (BB), Jennifer Wingard (JW), Nick Crews (NC), Amanda Tuttle (AT), Kellie Okonek (KO
Disclosures: None


    •  MOA GBOS Quarterly Meeting is scheduled for MON Oct 26 at 4PM at the Girdwood Community Room.
    •   Girdwood Trails Committee plans to apply for a Recreational Trails Program Grant to work on the Beaver Pond
         Trail. Comments are requested by Oct 30 to be included in the application. See meeting packet for additional
        information.
    •
Agenda Revisions and Approval:   September 30 2026 GBOS Work Session agenda     NC/AT Assent
 Amended to move Vacancy to item #1      NC/AT

Business:
    1. GHEC Vacancy (Wingard/Okonek)
Motion to appoint Lily Murolo to the Girdwood Housing and Economic Committee
Motion by JW/2nd AT
Motion carries by 5-0 in roll call vote.

    2. GBOS Bylaws revisions, starting at Article 11 (10, with earlier removal of original Article 10) (Wingard/Crews)
Group picks up at Original Article 11, which will become Article 10 when approved changes are adopted.

Article 11 (10 when revised)
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve amendments to Article 11 as proposed.
JW/NC

           GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos

Group considers other language changes to added language under F & G and runs through those changes line by line

GBOS moves to approve Sentence 1 (existing)
Motion carries 5-0

Group moves to approve suggested addition sentence 2.
Motion fails 2-3
Group moves to approve suggestion addition sentence 3.
Motion fails 2-3

Motion:
Article 11/10 is approved as amended.
Motion carries 4-1 in roll call vote (AT dissenting)

Article 12: Emergency Permitting
Items has moved to be a staff responsibility, not GBOS responsibility.

Motion:
GBOS moves to remove Article 12.
Motion by JW/AT
Motion carries by 5-0 in roll call vote

Article 13 (11 when revised: Amendments to the Rules and Procedures
Motion to amend as presented.
Motion by JW/AT
Amendment: add that Rules and Procedures should be reviewed annually.
Motion by BB/AT
Amendment approved 5-0 in roll call vote
Amended motion approved 5-0 in roll call vote.

Article 14: Staff Roles & Responsibilities
Motion to approve as presented
Motion by JW/AT
Motion carries 5-0

Motion to move this Article to be Attachment 1, as written
Motion by JW/BB
Motion carries 4-1 in roll call vote (NC dissenting)

Attachment 1 (2, when changes are made): Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct
Motion to approve changes as presented.
Motion by JW/NC
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

Motion:
GBOS moves to accept the current attachments 2 and 3 (3 and 4 when accepted) as presented
Motion by JW/BB
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

Group reviews suggestions from staff upon review of changes accepted from Meeting 1.

Motion:
GBOS moves to accept change in language for reconsideration vote so that yes means yes to reconsider; no means
not to reconsider.
Motion by JW/NC
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote


Group considers when the rules and procedures should be reviewed in the future, so that stay up to date. General
consensus is in the fall. No vote on this.
Group also discusses having revision history in the document.
                                                                                         2

Prior versions of Rules and Procedures are available at the GBOS office.

Motion
GBOS moves to add revision history to Rules and Procedures.
Motion by AT/2nd BB
Motion fails 1-4


Next steps are to accept changes to document, post for public review and comment for 28 days. GBOS wants for the
redline showing revisions to be posted as well as the document as revised. Item will be on agenda for hearing in
November.


Adjourn 2PM
